title.title: D&D: Dungeon Masters
title.overview: Dungeon Masters stars Jasmine Bhullar (DesiQuest, Dimension 20) as Dungeon Master, joined by Mayanna Berrin (Dispatch, The Dungeon Run), Christian Navarro (13 Reasons Why, Forgotten Realms), Neil Newbon (Baldur’s Gate III), and Devora Wilde (Baldur’s Gate III) and features an all-original score by five-time, Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone.

episodes.name: Mists Of Ravenloft
episodes.overview: An encounter with a Red Wizard of Thay has lasting consequences for an unlucky group of adventurers.

episodes.name: The Long Rest
episodes.overview: An undead threat tests the party’s ability to work together.

episodes.name: Tarokka
episodes.overview: An encounter with a Darklord changes everything.

episodes.name: Prison Break
episodes.overview: Our heroes venture deep into Prison Sorrow to break out a dangerous captive.

episodes.name: Eclipse
episodes.overview: A celebration turns into something much darker...

episodes.name: Curse Of Strahd
episodes.overview: The party goes to war with the Darklord of Barovia, Strahd von Zarovich.

episodes.name: Confession And Consolation
episodes.overview: Reeling from their brutal encounter with Strahd, the party must decide Zora's fate, receive magical items forged from their worst regrets, and face an unexpected offer that could change everything as they close in on the third banshee.

episodes.name: Lord Soth
episodes.overview: Lord Soth's wrath has shattered the realm, and our heroes must beat the unbeatable, escape the inescapable, and find their way home before everything they love is swallowed by the dark.

episodes.name: Shores of Innsmouth
episodes.overview: The party washes up on the shores of Innsmouth, haunted by visions of the sleeping Cthulhu. Can they escape this new realm of horror with their sanity intact?

episodes.name: Cult of Cthulhu
episodes.overview: As their descent into madness continues, the party encounters the Cult of the Chthonic Night.

episodes.name: Gathered Whispers
episodes.overview: The party's darkest secrets are laid bare during a cult ritual, revealing Zora's painful true history, and a mysterious ally from the Order of the Feather may be hiding in plain sight.

episodes.name: Dream’s End
episodes.overview: Desperate to escape Innsmouth, our heroes call on unexpected allies and a flash of holy light to stop a dark god from awakening and make their way home.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Misfits
episodes.overview: Ambushed by a Living Spell before they even leave the workshop, our heroes head into the Anauroch and are struck by a shared vision of alien hordes destroying Faerûn.

episodes.name: The Phaerimm Ambush
episodes.overview: A brutal trek leads to the lost expedition's wreaked campsite, where a strange rival faction searches for otherworldly answers.

similar.title: Nurse the Dead
similar.subtitle: 2026 • PG
similar.overview: Tasked with saving LA’s most haunted hospital ward, a highly motivated Filipina nurse with a third eye must manage unruly ghosts, burned-out staff, and one judgmental “coworker” who knows her better than anyone should.

similar.title: Grave Conversations
similar.overview: An unforgettable journey into the depths of human existence, while David Dastmalchian guides his guests through discussions that delve into personal reflections on mortality, legacy, and the afterlife, all while lying down in Titan caskets.

similar.title: The Studio
similar.overview: Paul, an underdog music producer, juggles family life and artistic dreams by working out of his home studio with a rotating cast of eccentric clients, creating original music and navigating hilarious family drama along the way.

similar.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
similar.subtitle: 2026 • TV-PG
similar.overview: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

similar.title: Mystery Files
similar.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

similar.title: Underverse
similar.overview: Sans traverses across the multiverse to stop a powerful threat that had lost everything, while meeting more variations of himself along the way.

similar.title: Dimension 20
similar.overview: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.

similar.title: Among Us
similar.subtitle: 2026 • TV-PG
similar.overview: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.
